caption: The drawing depicts three simplified, jointed wooden dolls arranged in a row with the letters B, A, and C beneath them from left to right. The central doll (A) is the largest and shown from the front, featuring a rounded head painted with a pale skin tone, short black hair, facial features including black eyes, a small red mouth, and pink cheeks, as well as a segmented wooden body in natural brown and beige tones with articulated limbs. The doll to the left (B) is shown from the back, with its head also painted black to indicate hair, a visible joint at the neck, and a similar segmented body and limbs as the central doll. The doll to the right (C) is smaller, shown from the front, with a pale face, fine black hair, and similar body structure and coloration as the other two dolls. The background is plain and uncolored.
title: Jointed Wooden Dolls
